business_summary: Century City International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property, construction and building, hotel, asset management, aircraft ownership and leasing, and investment businesses in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and internationally. The company's Property Development and Investment segment develops and sells properties; leases properties; and provides estate agency services. The Construction and Building Related Businesses segment is involved in construction works and building related businesses, including the provision of development consultancy and project management services, property management, security systems and products, and other software development and distribution services. The Hotel Operation and Management and Hotel Ownership segment engages in hotel operations and provision of hotel management services, and the ownership of hotel properties for rental. The Asset Management segment offers asset management services to Regal REIT. The Financial Assets Investments segment is involved in trading financial assets, and other financial assets investments. The Aircraft Ownership and leasing segment owns and leases aircraft. The Others segment provides financing, securities brokerage, and housekeeping and related services; sells food products; and operates and manages restaurants. It also provides management, nominee, corporate management, secretarial, financing, construction engineering, and lighting technology services; and mechanical and electrical engineering services, as well as engages in food and beverage, and hotel ownership operations; operates retail shops; passenger service licenses holding and vehicle ownership; holds trademark; provision of room reservation services. Century City International Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Century City International Holdings Limited는 홍콩, 중국 본토 및 국제적으로 부동산, 건설 및 건물, 호텔, 자산 관리, 항공기 소유 및 임대, 투자 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사의 부동산 개발 및 투자 부문은 부동산을 개발 및 판매합니다. 부동산 임대; 부동산 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 건설 및 건축 관련 비즈니스 부문은 개발 컨설팅 및 프로젝트 관리 서비스, 자산 관리, 보안 시스템 및 제품, 기타 소프트웨어 개발 및 유통 서비스 제공을 포함하여 건설 작업 및 건축 관련 비즈니스에 관여합니다. 호텔 운영 및 관리 및 호텔 소유권 부문은 호텔 운영, 호텔 관리 서비스 제공, 임대용 호텔 자산 소유권에 관여합니다. 자산 관리 부문은 Regal REIT에 자산 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 금융 자산 투자 부문은 금융 자산 거래 및 기타 금융 자산 투자에 관여합니다. 항공기 소유권 및 리스 부문은 항공기를 소유하고 리스합니다. 기타 부문 프로
